newsitem.title: SPAIN: SOCCER-BARCELONA DOCTORS HIT OUT AT 'IGNORANT' CRUYFF.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-BARCELONA DOCTORS HIT OUT AT 'IGNORANT' CRUYFF.

text.p: Club doctors at Barcelona have issued a statement accusing Johan Cruyff of trying to tell them them what to do with sometimes "catastrophic results" during his eight years in charge at the Camp Nou.

"(There are) people who, without any scientific preparation at all, try to criticise professionals from their ignorance," read the statement, which was issued in response to criticism of the medical staff made recently by Cruyff.

The statement said that Cruyff had contracted his own "pseudo-specialists". It also referred to Alberto Ferrer and Quique Alvarez, players who many commentators believe were forced to play before recovering fully from injuries.
Barcelona and Cruyff have fought a legal battle over supposedly unpaid wages and bonuses since the Dutchman was fired in May.
